# Vendored Phenix Flake Maintenance library

Temporary vendored `lib/` snapshot of standalone `phenix-flake-maintenance` commit `a3c3e80`.

The harness imports this library directly because the standalone GitHub repository cannot yet be created through the available GitHub integration. Once `github:matthis-k/phenix-flake-maintenance` exists, replace this directory with the normal flake input/library reference; the maintenance declaration and provider contract stay unchanged.
